Name: SOUND_AUTO_ENV_SOUND_GROUP_PARAM_ST
Description: Water sounds created from MSB Sound regions. Regions with the same Water Type and Water ID form one group, whose row ID is Water Type × 1000 + Water ID (Water Type 1 sea, 2 lake, 3 river; a Water Type above 3 uses row 0). The group plays one sound whose source follows the listener along the regions.

Fields.Name: Sound Number
Fields.Description: Sound ID (type a, environment sound) played by the group. -1: no sound.

Fields.Name: Expand Range
Fields.Description: The sound plays while the listener is within this distance (m) of the group's regions. 0: only while inside a region.

Fields.Name: Follow Speed
Fields.Description: Fixed part of the distance (m) the sound source moves toward its target each update. The target is the listener's position while inside a region, otherwise the nearest point of the regions. Step = Follow Speed + Follow Rate × remaining distance, never past the target.

Fields.Name: Follow Rate
Fields.Description: Proportional part of the sound source's step: this fraction of the remaining distance to the target is added each update (see Follow Speed).
